headline: The enhanced ACA subsidies expired on January 1, 2026
detail: Self-employed earners above 400% of the poverty line went back to paying full price on the exchange, and 2027 rates are rising for a second straight year.
employer_angle: Owners who relied on the exchange for their own coverage are now paying full price with nothing to show for it on the business side.
employee_angle: Staff buying their own exchange coverage lost the same help.

evidence.title: ACA Enhanced Subsidies Expired: Employer Impact
ACA Subsidies Ended in 2026: What Self-Employed Workers Should Do
ACA premiums jump for second straight year

headline: Employer premiums keep climbing
detail: KFF's 2026 Employer Health Benefits Survey puts average annual premiums at $9,804 for single and $28,303 for family coverage, and a Marsh survey expects at least another 8% next year.
employer_angle: Small firms feel every percentage point of increase in their margins.
employee_angle: Rising payroll deductions and deductibles cut into take-home pay.

evidence.title: Employer-Provided Health Insurance Costs Expected To Increase Next Year

headline: New plan structures are replacing traditional group coverage
detail: ICHRAs (now called CHOICE arrangements) and level-funded plans are being pitched to small businesses everywhere. Many owners are not sure which structure fits.
employer_angle: A side-by-side look at a group PPO versus an allowance-style arrangement makes the decision simple.
employee_angle: Employees often prefer a real plan with a known network over an allowance to shop on their own.

evidence.title: Small Business Health Insurance Options in 2026

headline: Health premiums are one of the cleanest tax strategies available to owners
detail: Employer-paid premiums are generally deductible and exempt from payroll taxes, and self-employed owners can generally deduct their own premiums.
employer_angle: Turn an after-tax personal expense into a deductible business benefit (confirm with your tax professional).
employee_angle: Employer-paid premiums are generally not taxable income to the employee.

evidence.title: Small Business Health Insurance in 2026: Tax Credits, ICHRA & Level-Funded Plans
5 Ways Self-Employed Folks Deduct Health Insurance (2026)

headline: Open enrollment for 2027 runs November 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027
detail: December 15 is the last day to enroll for coverage starting January 1.
employer_angle: A decision made before December 15 can start the new year on a better plan.
employee_angle: Families get coverage in place from January 1.

evidence.title: A Guide to Open Enrollment for Individual Health Insurance

headline: GLP-1 coverage is getting harder to find
detail: Employers and carriers have been tightening coverage for GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic and Mounjaro.
employer_angle: A plan with a defined GLP-1 path is a benefit employees notice.
employee_angle: On these plans, GLP-1s are covered with preauthorization every 6 months for members with an A1C of 6 or more, by mail order.
